# Anubhav Gain — Security Engineering Blog

> Security Software Engineer at Infopercept Consulting and CEO at TechAnv Consulting. Builder of production-grade security systems in Rust and Go. DevSecOps Expert, XDR/OXDR Platform Architect, eBPF Specialist. 222+ Research Citations.

Anubhav Gain (alias: mranv) writes about low-level security engineering, DevSecOps, Rust and Go systems programming, Windows kernel security, Kubernetes platform engineering, CTF writeups, and eBPF development. He is based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Author & Profile

- [About Anubhav Gain](https://mranv.pages.dev/about/): Full bio, expertise, and contact information
- [GitHub (mranv)](https://github.com/mranv): Personal open-source projects — Rust, eBPF, security tools
- [GitHub (Infopercept)](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl): Organization projects — Leviathan, Krustron, Agni, opensearch-rust-sdk

## Flagship Open-Source Projects

- [Leviathan](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/leviathan): Windows kernel-mode EDR/XDR security framework in safe Rust (KMDF v1.33, Ring 0, five kernel callbacks, MITRE ATT&CK mapping across 16 techniques, pool-tag memory forensics, SSDT/IDT/MSR hook scanning, ELAM, zero-copy MDL ring buffer)
- [Krustron](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/krustron): Open-source Devtron alternative for Kubernetes platform engineering (Go, unified dashboard, GitOps CI/CD, multi-cluster, RBAC, observability)
- [Agni](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/agni): Terminal UI for Firecracker microVMs built on Bubble Tea (Go) — interactive alternative to firectl
- [opensearch-rust-sdk](https://github.com/Infopercept/opensearch-rust-sdk): High-performance async-first Rust SDK for the OpenSearch Extensions API
- [ebpf-file-monitor (RustInotifyTracker)](https://github.com/mranv/ebpf-file-monitor): eBPF file monitoring with inotify in Rust — timestamped change tracking
- [rshell](https://github.com/mranv/rshell-backdoor): Rust bind and reverse shell for ethical security research
- [status](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/status): Enterprise-grade status page and monitoring platform in Go
- [vibe](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/vibe): Curated AI system prompt library for software engineering workflows
- [ocsf-rust-crawler](https://github.com/mranv/ocsf-rust-crawler): OCSF JSON crawler in Rust with scheduled HTTP fetching
- [r-logger](https://github.com/mranv/r-logger): Lightweight Rust logging utility for activity and query tracking

## App Control for Business Series

A comprehensive 8-part series on Microsoft App Control for Business (WDAC/AppLocker), plus 12 file rule level references and 21 rule option references.

- [Part 1: Introduction & Key Concepts](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-1-introduction-keyconcepts/): Why application control matters, key use cases, deployment, licensing
- [Part 2: Policy Templates & Rule Options](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-2-policy-templates-rule-options/): Policy templates and rule option overview
- [Part 3: AppID Tagging & Managed Installer](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-3-appid-tagging-managed-installer/): AppID tagging and managed installer configuration
- [Part 4: Starter Base Policy (Lightly Managed)](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-4-starter-base-policy-lightly-managed/): Base policy for lightly managed devices
- [Part 5: Base Policy (Fully Managed Devices)](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-5-base-policy-fully-managed-devices/): Full lockdown policy for managed endpoints
- [Part 6: Sign, Apply & Remove Signed Policies](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-6-sign-apply-remove-signed-policies/): Policy signing and deployment lifecycle
- [Part 7: Maintaining Policies with Azure DevOps & PowerShell](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-7-maintaining-policies-azuredevops-powershell/): CI/CD-driven policy management
- [Part 8: AppLocker, Option 13 & Selective MSI Allowlisting](https://mranv.pages.dev/posts/app-control-part-8-applocker-option13-selective-msi-allowlisting/): End-to-end MSI allowlisting
